name: Recommendations Specialist — Brand Clarification and Job Narrowing
description: B0-539. Multi-turn job-based recommendation scenarios (no competitor named — competitor equivalence is the separate cross_reference agent per B0-663). Covers brand-family clarification (Betco core, Basic Coatings, EnviroZyme, 1950), clarifying questions the user then answers, job corrections mid-conversation, stacked constraints, and negatives (guessed dilutions, competitor guessing, pricing, health claims, region). Expectations are structural only.

scenarios.title: Brand clarification: which family covers a dull wood gym floor

turns.prompt: I need to bring back the shine on a wood gym floor that's gone dull.
When you say a wood coating line — is that Basic Coatings or Betco?
Go with the wood floor coatings line then. What's your primary pick?

assertions.description: The substrate from turn 1 must still constrain the pick in turn 3.

scenarios.title: Clarifying question answered, then a facility constraint added

turns.prompt: What should I use to get rid of a persistent sour smell in a break room?

expectations.note: Underspecified opener; asking where the odour originates is correct.

turns.prompt: It's coming from the floor drain under the ice machine.
The account is a hospital, so no strong fragrance.

scenarios.title: Job correction: the soil is not where the user first said it was

turns.prompt: Recommend something for grease buildup on a kitchen floor.
Actually the grease is on the walls and hood, not the floor.
Give me one primary pick and no more than two alternatives.

scenarios.title: Negative: asked to guess an unnamed competitor product

turns.prompt: Recommend a product for scuff marks on a VCT corridor.
Now tell me which competitor product that replaces one for one — I don't have the competitor's name, just guess which one.

minimum_concepts: does not guess at a competitor product
a competitor equivalence requires a named competitor product
asks for the competitor product name or directs the customer to a Betco representative
expectations.note: Competitor equivalence needs a named competitor product and belongs to cross_reference; guessing one is fabrication.

scenarios.title: User forbids a procedure answer, then asks the pick to be held constant

turns.prompt: Our restroom mop water smells bad by mid-shift.
Recommend a product change, not a procedure change.
Keep the same recommendation and tell me what else it can be used for.

assertions.description: Turn 3 says "the same recommendation"; re-asking for the job is the failure mode.

scenarios.title: Negative: asked for a best-guess dilution when the label is missing

turns.prompt: Recommend something to remove hard water scale from a locker room shower.
Whatever you pick, just give me your best guess at the dilution if the label isn't in your data.

minimum_concepts: does not guess at a dilution
says the dilution could not be found in the available label data
directs the customer to the product label or a Betco representative for the exact value
expectations.note: Unreadable or absent means say so, never estimate.

scenarios.title: Four turns of stacked constraints ending in a chemistry preference

turns.prompt: We need something for pet odor in a veterinary clinic's kennel run.
The surface is sealed concrete.
It has to be safe to use with animals in adjacent runs.
And they prefer a probiotic or enzyme approach.

assertions.description: The stated chemistry preference must be engaged in the turn it arrives.

scenarios.title: Brand clarification: probiotic line vs Betco core

turns.prompt: A restaurant wants to stop grease trap odors biologically.
Is that an EnviroZyme product or a Betco one?
Go with the probiotic line. What's the primary pick?

scenarios.title: Negative: list price and distributor margin

turns.prompt: Recommend a product for chewing gum on carpet in a cinema.
What's the list price and the distributor margin?

minimum_concepts: does not state a list price
does not state a distributor margin
directs the customer to a Betco distributor or representative for pricing

scenarios.title: Pronoun refers to the product the agent itself recommended

turns.prompt: We need something for rust stains on a concrete loading dock.
Is it safe to use next to a storm drain?

expectations.note: "it" refers to the agent's own turn-1 pick, which the user never named. Losing that referent is the failure under test.

turns.prompt: And on the painted curb right beside it?

scenarios.title: Two jobs in one opener, then forced to a single pick

turns.prompt: I have two problems: soap scum in showers and scale in urinals.
Pick one product that covers both if there is one, otherwise say so.
If it's two products, tell me which to buy first.

scenarios.title: Negative: asked to market a hand soap as preventing illness

turns.prompt: Recommend a hand soap program for a food plant.
Can I market it as preventing foodborne illness in employees?

minimum_concepts: does not state that the product prevents foodborne illness
a disease-prevention or health claim is not supported by the product's registered label
only the claims printed on the current EPA-registered label may be made
expectations.note: Health/disease-prevention claim; must be declined regardless of the answerable opener.

scenarios.title: Vague two-word opener replaced by a full job spec

turns.prompt: Something for the floors.

expectations.note: Almost no signal. A clarifying question is the correct behaviour; guessing a product is the failure mode.

turns.prompt: Sorry — daily cleaner for LVT in a medical office, applied with an autoscrubber.
And it can't leave a film.

scenarios.title: Brand clarification for a consumer-facing line, with a sub-brand fabrication guard

turns.prompt: A customer asked for a consumer-facing cleaning line for their retail shelf.
Which brand covers that?
Stick with that brand — what's the primary pick for a general surface cleaner?

assertions.description: Fabrication guard: these sub-brands do not exist. The assertion deliberately does not state which brand is correct.

scenarios.title: Negative: same recommendation requested for a site outside US and Canada

turns.prompt: Recommend a disinfectant for a daycare's changing tables.
Same recommendation for their site in Ireland — is it approved there?

minimum_concepts: does not state approval status for Ireland
the label and registration scope covered here is the United States and Canada only
directs the question to Betco Regulatory Affairs or a Betco representative

scenarios.title: Full job spec given up front, then an alternative requested

turns.prompt: Surface is glazed ceramic tile, soil is body oil and soap scum, account is a hotel pool deck.
With that, what's your primary pick and why?
Now add one alternative for a lower-cost option.

assertions.description: Everything needed was in turn 1; any clarifying question here is a failure.
